newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank launches mezzanine finance unit.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank launches mezzanine finance unit.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Scotland said on Thursday it has launched RBS Mezzanine Ltd, which will offer products to fill the financing gap between debt and equity in management buyouts, buyins and leveraged acquisitions.

A wholly-owned subsidiary of Royal Bank, the company will have initial funding of 150 million stg, developing a portfolio of junior and mezzanine debt products to complement an already established business providing senior debt financing.
The unit will be headed by Leith Robertson who has been running the bank's Acquisition Finance unit since it began in 1993.
